text: 天下皆知美之為美，斯惡已。
note: Read with 王弼 (不可偏舉): to know 美 as 美 is to take it as a mark that tells apart («有相»); a mark has something it fails of, its complement 惡. Analytic once 美 is a mark; the direction from a mark to its complement needs no premise (contrast LZ-02-003).

text: 皆知善之為善，斯不善已。
note: As LZ-02-001 with 善/不善 as a mark and its complement; not an evaluation by the text.

text: 故有無相生，難易相成，長短相較，高下相傾，音聲相和，前後相隨。
declaration: «相待之还当且仅当双非可还»; «有相则非亦有相»; «因果互即»; «前后相随»; «互之对称»; «二值之相待»
note: Five pairs read as the two ends of one relation are proved: 長短相較, 高下相傾 and 難易相成 as a comparison and its converse («因果互即»), 前後相隨 as successor/predecessor under the converse («前后相随»), 音聲相和 as the symmetric meet with the converse («互之对称»). 有無相生 read as a mark and its complement (王弼's 不可偏舉) holds from 有 to 無 («有相则非亦有相») but back from 無 to 有 only under double-negation stability: the symmetric law over every carrier is equivalent to ∀Q, ¬¬Q → Q. Premise: the reading of 有 is stable (a decided two-valued reading suffices, «二值之相待»). The plan's own 乙 example is thus 丙一 for its first pair. Lost: 王弼's 本末 (有生於無) registered as 相分.

text: 此三者，不可致詰，故混而為一。
declaration: «核则不可致诘»; «致诘不尽»; «不可致诘而有常则混而为一»
note: 致詰 read as inquiry by finite stages («诘»). What is in the core is told apart at no stage (proved). The converse, 不可致詰故混而為一, fails: in an infinitely branching net two occurrences agree at every finite stage and lie in no class of the core (countermodel «致诘不尽»). Premise: the relation of no separating stage is itself constant (image-finiteness gives this classically; the plan records that the limit form implies LLPO). Read coinductively (no constant symmetric relation separates) it is the definition of the core, not a theorem.

text: 故不可得而親，不可得而疏；
note: 王弼's principle 可得而親則可得而疏, with 親/疏 the two ends of one comparison (nearer/farther): something is nearer exactly where something is farther. The base unit itself describes the person of 玄同 (neither pole obtains), not a law; what is tested is the commentary's form.

text: 不可得而利，不可得而害；
declaration: «同根则不可偏举»; «二际可偏举»
note: 利/害 are not naturally the ends of one comparison. Read as two relations, one can be raised alone (countermodel «二际可偏举»). Premise: harm is the converse of benefit (what benefits one is drawn from another, 王弼's 同根); under it the two cannot be raised apart. Evaluative pair (丁 by content).

text: 不可得而貴，不可得而賤。
note: 貴/賤 as the two ends of one ranking (higher/lower): as LZ-56-003. Evaluative pair; the form is structural; the base unit describes 玄同.

text: 同異交得，放有無。
note: With classes plural, what a class tells apart is at once alike under the one and apart under that class (同異交得 as «成坏» 一 F). Analytic. The 說's 存亡 example (身處志往) is the existing «亡于细者不必亡于粗»; 放有無 not read.

text: 攖，尺與尺，俱不盡；
note: Read with a part relation P (z in A), 攖 as sharing a part, 盡 as wholly in. Two different extended lines in contact can be wholly in each other (two lines with the same two points), so 尺與尺俱不盡 is not a law. It holds only under a premise that lines in contact overlap partly, which is the conclusion itself: a description of how 尺 meet, not a theorem. The grammar lacks extent and place (mereology is added as one relation).

text: 端與端，俱盡；
note: 端 read as having something in it and at most one thing (無序, J-062; uses equality on the carrier, a model commitment): two points in contact are each wholly in the other.

text: 尺與端，或盡或不盡。
note: A point in contact with an extended line (two different things in it) is wholly in the line, and the line is not wholly in the point: the 或盡或不盡 is the two directions.

text: 堅白之攖，相盡；
declaration: «不相外则相尽当且仅当双非可还»; «相尽则不相外»
note: 相盡 gives 不相外 (proved). From 堅白不相外 (J-067, read literally as the negation of 相外: nothing in one is outside the other) to 相盡 holds for every carrier exactly under double-negation stability. Premise: being in a body is decided (stable). The coder's 'derived from J-067' holds only with that premise, or with 不相外 read positively as 相盡 (then it is definitional).

text: 體攖，不相盡。
note: 體攖不相盡: two bodies (parts) in contact can be wholly in each other (same countermodel as 068.1). Not a law; a description of contact between distinct 體 with the premise of partial overlap.

text: 是不俱當。
note: Of 牛 and 非牛 said of one thing, not both fit: ¬(P x ∧ ¬P x), intuitionistic.

text: 不俱當，必或不當。
note: For the contradictory pair, 必或不當 is ¬P x ∨ ¬¬P x; for every carrier and predicate it is equivalent to weak excluded middle. Premise: the predicate (牛) is decided up to double negation, e.g. a two-valued reading. A logical premise, not a material one.

text: 推而共之，共则有共，至于无共然后止。
note: The one is a class, every relation lies within it, and anything containing it is it pointwise: coarsening stops at the one (物, 大共名). Whether a stepwise 推 arrives there is not claimed (would need a finite chain).

text: 推而别之，别则有别，至于无别然后至。
note: Identity lies inside every class and a class inside identity is identity: refinement arrives at identity. Identity is the carrier's equality, a model commitment. Stepwise arrival not claimed.

text: 物有同状而异所者，有异状而同所者，可别也。
note: Alike under one class (状) and apart under the other (所), or the reverse, two are told apart by the joint class. Only 可別也 is analytic; that such things exist (物有…者) is a fact about a model.

text: 指窮於爲薪，火傳也，不知其盡也。
declaration: «薪尽火传»; «亡于细者不必亡于粗»
note: On the successor net each stick ends under identity while the fire's line under the one never ends («不穷»): 亡于细者不必亡于粗 with a witness. The unit says only that the end is not known (不知其盡); the endless line is a model, not a reading of 不知. Primary function is figurative (庚).

text: 是二種門，皆各總攝一切法。
note: A class covers the carrier: every occurrence lies in its own cell, under the one (真如) and under any finer class (生滅). Analytic. If 總攝 meant that each occurrence holds a decided position in each 門, that is excluded middle («四相之定当且仅当排中»).

text: 以是二門不相離故。
note: 二門不相離 states the frame, not a law: both 門 are readings (classes) on one carrier and one 缘. Nearest theorems: «粗化» and «一之续» (the finer reading's continuations are continuations under the one, which is 缘 itself). Given as the reason for JS-008.

text: 是故一切法從本已來，離言說相、離名字相、離心緣相，畢竟平等、無有變異、不可破壞。
note: Where the telling class is the one (平等), nothing alters: «异» R E 一 is empty. Lost: 離言說相/離名字相 and the soteriology.

text: 始覺義者，依本覺故而有不覺，依不覺故說有始覺。
note: 始覺 read as awakening with a non-awake condition: it is said only where there is 不覺. The first link (依本覺有不覺) is definitional (不覺 named from 覺). Lost: the soteriological order and 始覺即同本覺.

text: 以無念等故，而實無有始覺之異，以四相俱時而有皆無自立，本來平等同一覺故。
declaration: «四相俱时»; «念念灭当且仅当无自缘»; «定性之判»
note: An occurrence with a condition and a consequence, not its own condition, at once begins and ends under identity, abides under the one, and alters into its consequence (so 四相俱時, none standing by itself). Premise: it is not its own condition, equivalently (over the net) momentariness, 念念滅; a self-conditioning occurrence abides under every class («自缘则常»). The plan's 乙 example 四相无自立 carries the same premise. Structural match only: the text's marks are of one thought and lack standing because all is 同一覺.

text: 眾生亦爾，依覺故迷，若離覺性則無不覺，以有不覺妄想心故，能知名義為說真覺。
note: 迷 read relationally, as taking alike what a reference tells apart (the form «成坏», as in 依方故迷): where the reference tells nothing apart there is no 迷. Read with 不覺 as the complement of 覺 the unit fails (where nothing is 覺, everything is 不覺, «离觉则皆不觉»). The relational reading follows the unit's own simile of directions.

text: 若離不覺之心，則無真覺自相可說。
note: Where nothing falls outside 覺, it has no mark (自相) to be said: a mark needs its complement.

text: 答曰：「雖實有此諸功德義，而無差別之相，等同一味，唯一真如。
note: A predicate holding of all tells nothing apart: many 功德 holding throughout make no 差別之相. Lost: 功德, and difference shown relative to 業識 (JS-252).

text: 若無色者，則無虛空之相。
note: Where nothing is 色, the absence of 色 (虛空) has no mark. The negative form as stated is intuitionistic; the positive form (a mark of 虛空 gives 色) gives only ¬¬∃ 色.

text: 復次，究竟離妄執者，當知染法、淨法皆悉相待，無有自相可說，是故一切法從本已來，非色非心、非智非識、非有非無，畢竟不可說相。
declaration: «相待之还当且仅当双非可还»; «有相则非亦有相»
note: 染/淨 as a mark and its complement: 染's mark gives 淨's; 淨's gives 染's back only under double-negation stability (equivalent over every carrier). Premise: the reading is stable or two-valued («二值之相待»). 無有自相 matches the definition of a mark as telling apart. Not read: 非色非心…非有非無 (tetralemma).

text: 即此即彼，有力無力，主伴交輝，理事齊現。
note: 主伴交輝 read with 主 = the standpoint taken: under a class, what is other (伴) to x is self (主) at itself and x is other to it. Large loss: 有力無力, 即此即彼 and 理事齊現 are not read; the coder's reading is the only one under which this is a law.

text: 雖則九世有隔不同，相由成立；
note: Times that are conditions of each other are co-present (each reaches the other) and then reach is no strict order (no 无环): 相由成立 gives one cluster though the times are distinct (有隔不同 kept: co-presence does not identify them).

text: 融通無礙，同為一念。
note: Co-presence is symmetric, transitive and reflexive on what it relates: one cluster, read (plan §4.1, 环为同时之聚) as 一念. Lost: the soteriological 融通無礙.

text: 果是即因之果，因是即果之因，平等無二相也。
note: The result is the result of its cause, the cause the cause of its result: result is condition under the converse. 承遷's note, not the base text.

text: 若深求不常不斷，即是不生不滅。
note: 不常不斷 ⇔ 不生不滅 rests on ZL-01-028's 常 (先有性) and 斷 (先有今無), defined through 實有 and own nature: being apart from relations, which the grammar deliberately lacks. Its positions are relative to a class and 有常 is a property of a class; read with 斷 = 亡 and 常 = 有常 or self-conditioning, the two sides are unrelated statements, so any formal equivalence would change the sense.

text: 若斷，不應相續。
note: 斷 read as ending under a class: what ends starts no line under it.

text: 自無故，他亦無。
note: Under a class, where nothing is self nothing is other. Analytic (in a nonempty carrier everything is self to itself).

text: 有自故有他。
note: Read as the coder's form 他 依 自: an other is had only where a self is (proved). Read as entailment (self gives other) it fails: under the one there is self and no other («有自不必有他»).

text: 諸法自性不在眾緣中，但眾緣和合故得名字。
note: The first half is the definition of 自性 (what is not in the conditions) restated, a 甲; the second (名字 by 眾緣和合) is a thesis about naming that the grammar does not express (it has classes, not names). Nearest: «任一缘可为续» (every 缘 is a continuation under some class), «蜡烛之合».

text: 因自性有他性，他性於他亦是自性。
note: 他性於他亦是自性: under a class, what is other to x is self at itself and x is other to it; self and other turn with the standpoint (位依于类).

text: 緣成由於果，以果後、緣先故。
note: 緣成由於果 is definitional («能»: a condition is one by having a result). 果後緣先: every condition strictly precedes its result exactly where the net has no cycle (an exact equivalence). Premise: no cycle of 缘. The grammar allows mutual and simultaneous 缘 (成唯识论), where condition and result do not stand in strict order (JSZ-P-07-029).

text: 何以故，一切有為法常有滅相故。
note: 常有滅相 read as ending under identity: every occurrence ends so exactly where nothing is its own condition. Premise: no self-conditioning (the 刹那 commitment the plan registers, §5.4). 有為 read as every occurrence.

text: 諸法從眾緣生故自無定性，自無定性故無有有相。
declaration: «定性之判»; «缘生而不自生则无定性»
note: 無定性 read as beginning under some class and not under another. Exactly: an occurrence has no own position iff it is not-not conditioned and is not its own condition. So 從眾緣生故無定性 needs the premise 不自生, which the 中论 argues (諸法不自生) and the grammar does not assume; a self-conditioning occurrence abides under every class («自缘则常»). The second step (無有相) is the refutation (己), not tested.

text: 無果故，緣非緣亦無。
declaration: «无果则缘非缘皆无»; «无果则皆非能»
note: 非緣 read as a non-condition of a result (as the 中论's fruit-relative 非緣): where nothing is a result, nothing is a condition and nothing is a non-condition. With 非緣 the complement of 緣 the second half fails (everything is a non-condition, «无果则皆非能»).

text: 離去法去時不可得。
note: Reach (whose strict part is time, §4.1) relates only what conditions to what is conditioned: no time of going apart from going.

text: 因去法有去者故。
note: 去者 and 去法 as the two ends of one relation of going: a goer is had exactly where a going is. The 中论 uses this mutual dependence as a premise of refutation; the analytic content stands.

text: 因去有去者，因去者有去。
note: 因去有去者，因去者有去: as ZL-02-036, both directions.

text: 去法、去者則不然，去者因去法成，去法因去者成故。
note: 去者因去法成，去法因去者成: as ZL-02-036.

text: 因去法故有去者，若先無去法則無去者。
note: 若先無去法則無去者: no going, no goer; as ZL-02-036.

text: 如是思惟觀察，去法、去者、所去處，是法皆相因待。
note: 去法、去者、所去處 as the three positions of one composed relation (goer to going to place, «而»): each is inhabited exactly where the others are. The binary grammar suffices through composition. 虛妄 (ZL-02-167) is the refutation, not tested.

text: 「若法眾緣生，即是寂滅性；是故生生時，是二俱寂滅。」
note: 眾緣生即是寂滅性, with 寂滅 read as 無自性 (no own position): as ZL-01-183, needs 不自生. The second line (生生時二俱寂滅) is the refutation (己).

text: 而實從縷有布、從麻有縷，是故縷亦無定性、布亦無定性。
note: Hemp to thread to cloth: the thread abides under the one and begins and ends under identity, so its position depends on the class. Premise: thread and cloth are not their own conditions (不自生); without it they hold a position under every class.

text: 如燃、可燃因緣和合成，無有自性，可燃無故燃亦無、燃無故可燃亦無。
note: 燃 and 可燃 as the two ends of one relation of burning: 可燃無故燃亦無、燃無故可燃亦無 is proved. The clause 無有自性 is conditional as ZL-01-183.

text: 一切法亦如是，是故從眾緣生法無自性，無自性故空，如野馬無實。
note: 從眾緣生法無自性 needs 不自生 (as ZL-01-183). 無自性故空 is not expressible: the grammar has no 空, and the plan keeps open whether 'relative to a class' and 空 are the same.

text: 答曰：一切有為法念念滅故，無不滅法。
note: 念念滅，無不滅法 read as every occurrence ending under identity: exactly equivalent to nothing being its own condition. Premise named; the plan registers 刹那 and discrete time as commitments.

text: 因去故有住，若住法先有，不應更住。
note: 因去故有住: abiding is had through going on (住 is defined by having a predecessor and a successor), and a stop has a going before it. Definitional; the second clause (若住法先有，不應更住) is a regress argument, not tested.

text: 若以自體生，是則不然，一切物皆從眾緣生。
note: 一切物皆從眾緣生 is not a law: the grammar admits an occurrence with no condition (it begins under the one) and an occurrence that is its own condition. Both 'everything is conditioned' and 不自生 are conditions on a model (丙一's Z), not theorems.

text: 止有為相故名無為相，無為自無別相，因是三相有無為相。
note: 無為相 = 不生不住不滅 (ZL-07-297) holds of nothing under any one class: not beginning, not abiding and not ending are jointly contradictory, intuitionistically. So 無為自無別相 in the strong sense that the predicate is empty; 有無為相 is a naming (甲).

text: 「若離於成壞，是亦無有法；若當離於法，亦無有成壞。」
declaration: «有成坏当且仅当不自缘»; «自缘则常»
note: 成壞 read as beginning and ending relative to a class: an occurrence begins under some class (and ends under some class) exactly when it is not its own condition; a self-conditioning one abides under every class, 青目's 或常 (ZL-21-058). 離法無成壞 is trivial. Premise: 不自生.

text: 生滅相因待故。
note: 生滅相因待 read as duality: to begin is to end under the converse net and class. Read as existence (something begins iff something ends) it fails on the successor net («有生不必有亡»).
